<cite ref="Bava Batra 167b:15">B. Bath. 167ᵇ</cite> <he>בגר לה קלא</he> her voice has become rough (from old age).—Denom. <cite ref="B00082"><he>בַּגִּיר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to produce a rough surface, to heat and bruise by friction.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 66a">Nidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>שפופרת אַבְגּוּרֵי מבגר לה</he> Ar. (Var. <he>אנג׳ מנג׳</he>, ed. <he>אפג׳ מפג׳</he>) will not a tube bruise her?—
<cite ref="Ketubot 65a">Keth. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>מבגר לה</he> (the ropes of the bedstead) hurt her.
